# Coding-AI Prompt: Assurestor-Style Landing Page

## 1. Project Overview
Build a complete, responsive landing page for a **fictional** brand (invent a new brand name, product, and all copy — never use "Assurestor" or any real trademark). The visual language is an "electric terminal in a deep forest vault": a deep forest-green canvas with a single electric lime as the only signal of action. Dark-mode-first, chromatically disciplined (green-monochrome + white + lime only).

## 2. Architecture & Rules
- **CSS-First, Zero Inline CSS:** All styling in `style.css`. No `style="..."` attributes. Class/ID selectors only. Clean, semantic HTML.
- **CSS Variables:** Define all tokens in `:root` and `.dark`/`@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)`. Required tokens:
  - Colors: `--color-forest-canopy: #203400`, `--color-vault-floor: #1b2d00`, `--color-canopy-mid: #335400`, `--color-lime-phosphor: #bdff00`, `--color-moss-border: #586740`, `--color-fern: #73a303`, `--color-white: #ffffff`, plus semantic `--primary`, `--secondary`, `--bg-primary`, `--bg-secondary`, `--text-primary`, `--text-secondary`, `--border-default`, `--text-success`, `--text-error`, `--border-error`, `--border-success`.
  - Contrast pairing: light bg → dark text, dark bg → light text in every theme.
  - Light-mode background must not be pure white; use `#fefefe` where near-white is needed. (Dark theme is default; light theme still defined.)
  - Radius/shadows: `--radius-sm`, `--radius-md`, `--radius-lg`, `--shadow-sm`, `--shadow-md`.
  - Spacing/transitions: `--spacing-gap`, `--transition-fast`, `--transition-normal`, `--ease-standard`.
  - Elevation: `--z-dropdown`, `--z-modal`, `--z-toast`.
- **Dark Mode Mandatory:** Implement via `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and `.dark` class. Persist choice in `localStorage`, fall back to `prefers-color-scheme`. Visible toggle with correct `aria-pressed`/`aria-label`.
- **Flexbox:** `display: flex` with `align-items: center` default. Mobile-responsive (rows → columns). No horizontal scroll.
- **Tailwind CSS** via `@layer`/`@apply` unless otherwise; utilities map to CSS variables or reusable classes (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`).
- **Google Fonts Mandatory:** Text via Google Font `<link>`/`@import` (Space Grotesk primary, Inter Tight fallback; JetBrains Mono/IBM Plex Mono for micro-labels). Icons via Google Material Symbols. No inline SVGs or local icon files.
- **Naming:** BEM or fixed utility set consistently. No mixed conventions.

## 3. Design Tokens (Assurestor)
- Base unit 8px. Comfortable density.
- Spacing: 8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 72, 80, 120, 240px.
- Radii: tags 12px, cards 32px, pills 9999px, buttons 16px, body-blocks 24px, alternate-button 20px.
- Page max-width 1280px. Section gap 80px. Card padding 40px. Element gap 24px.
- Typography: Denim Ink (Space Grotesk) weights 400/600/700; sizes 16/20/32/40/64/86/94px; line-height 1.0–1.5; tracking -0.045em display, -0.022em heading, -0.02em body. Courier New (JetBrains Mono) 8px, tracking -0.14em for micro-labels.
- Type scale: body-sm 16px/1.5/-0.32px; body 20px/1.5/-0.4px; subheading 32px/1.2/-0.7px; heading-sm 40px/1.1/-0.88px; heading 64px/1.0/-1.35px; display 94px/1.0/-4.23px.

## 4. Component Specifications
- **Lime Primary Button:** `#bdff00` bg, `#1b2d00`/`#203400` text, 16px radius, 18px 32px padding. Denim Ink 400–600, 16–18px. Only fully filled button. States: hover (brightness/shadow, cursor pointer), focus (ring via CSS vars), active (scale 0.97), loading (spinner, disabled), disabled (opacity 0.5, greyscale, not-allowed), success/error (temp feedback).
- **Ghost Outline Button:** transparent bg, 1px `#ffffff` border, white text, 16px radius, 18px 32px padding. Denim Ink 400.
- **Pill Nav Link:** 9999px radius, ~10px horizontal padding, Denim Ink 400, white text, transparent bg. Login uses same pill + white 1px border.
- **Featured Lime Panel:** `#bdff00` bg, 32px radius, 40px padding. Decorative illustration inside.
- **Dark Content Card:** `#1b2d00` or `#203400` bg, 32px radius, 40px padding. No border/shadow. White text.
- **Elevated Accent Card:** `#335400` bg, 32px radius, 40px padding.
- **Hairline Divider:** 1px `#586740` or low-opacity white.
- **Active Dot Indicator:** 8px solid `#bdff00` circle inline before caption.
- **Section Eyebrow Label:** 8px lime dot + Denim Ink 8–16px white caption, tight tracking, dot above text.
- **Headline Block:** Denim Ink 600–700, 64–94px, line-height 1.0, -0.045em tracking, white.
- **Ghost Input Field:** transparent or `#203400` bg, 1px white border, 12–16px radius, Denim Ink 16px white text, ~10px vertical padding, muted white placeholder.
- **CTA/Feature Card with Image:** `#1b2d00` surface, 32px radius, two-column (text 60% / image 40%) or stacked, 40px padding, no shadow.
- Cards: hover elevation/transform translateY(-2px); focus-within highlight; skeleton loading shimmer; empty state with Google Icon + guidance text.

## 5. Page Sections
1. **Hero:** slim top nav (logo left, nav center, login + lime CTA right). Two-column split: text block 60% (eyebrow + 64–94px headline + body + 2–3 buttons) left; decorative lime panel 40% right.
2. **Features:** 3 cards (Dark Content Card style), each with eyebrow dot, title, body, optional icon.
3. **How It Works:** 3 steps, numbered, with hairline dividers.
4. **Testimonials:** quote cards.
5. **Pricing:** 3 tiers (Dark Content Card + Elevated Accent Card for highlighted).
6. **FAQ:** accordion-style, keyboard accessible.
7. **Final CTA:** centered headline + lime button + lime panel accent.
8. **Footer:** secondary links, hairline divider.

## 6. UX & Micro-interactions
- Responsive, fluid, no horizontal overflow.
- CSS transitions on all state changes (`transition: var(--transition-normal)`), respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Accessibility: sufficient contrast both themes; never color-only state communication; semantic HTML5; ARIA roles/labels; logical focus order; full keyboard operability; `aria-live` for dynamic feedback.
- Mandatory visual feedback on every interaction.
- Destructive actions visually distinct in both themes.

## 7. Do's and Don'ts
- Lime is the ONLY filled action color; ration it.
- Headlines 64–94px, weight 600–700, -0.045em tracking.
- Layer surfaces #1b2d00 → #203400 → #335400; no gray neutrals.
- 32px cards, 16px buttons, 9999px pills for nav/tags.
- 8px lime dot before every eyebrow.
- Body text Denim Ink 400, 16–20px, white, line-height 1.5, -0.02em tracking.
- 80px vertical section gaps.
- No drop shadows for elevation (color tier shifts only).
- No gray (#808080, #999) for any UI.
- No body text below 16px except 8px Courier micro-labels.
- One accent green per surface.
- No gradients.
- No weight 700 below 32px.

## 8. Imagery
Minimal illustrative photography. Flat lime-green geometric illustrations (hourglass, concentric circles) in pixelated/dot-matrix style. Contained in 32px-radius panels, never full-bleed. No lifestyle photography, no people. Line-based thin-stroke icons, monochromatic white or lime.

## 9. Deliverables
Separate `index.html`, `style.css`, `script.js`. No inline `<script>` beyond single deferred entry-point. All user-facing copy in English. Invent fictional brand name, product, and copy — never use real brand name, logo, trademarks, or product names. Placeholders only where content genuinely unspecified. Include dark-mode toggle, FAQ accordion, and form states per spec. Ensure all component states (button, card, input, modal) are implemented.

## 10. Exception Clause
If any requested style cannot be achieved without adding markup (e.g., missing wrapper/icon), stop and ask the user rather than silently inserting new HTML. No behavioral JS for validation/popups/utilities beyond theme toggle; ask user how to handle. No new HTML elements in edit mode. (This is a from-scratch build, so full markup is allowed.)
